notes.title: Vertical Velocity Re-haul Coming Late October
notes.notes: [p]I’ve been working on a complete re-haul of [b]Vertical Velocity[/b], and I’m excited to share what’s coming in the late October update. This isn’t just a patch—it’s a full refresh of the game with new systems, content, and polish across the board.[/p][h3]What’s New and Improved[/h3][list][*][p][b]Player Overhaul[/b] – The Sun has updated movement polish, improved responsiveness, a new trail effect, and added death animations for better feedback.[/p][/*][*][p][b]The Moon & Cutscenes[/b] – The Moon has been visually reworked, and the opening cutscene has been updated to create a stronger narrative introduction.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Expanded World[/b] – Six new areas have been added, each with 4–5 unique handcrafted levels. These stages include multiple boss mechanics and refined assets to give the world a stronger thematic identity.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Hazards & Interactions[/b] – Lava geysers and other environmental obstacles bring more variety and challenge to the climb.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Music Revamp[/b] – The soundtrack has been refreshed with updated tracks to better fit the mood and momentum of each stage.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Speedrun Support[/b] – The Speed Run Manager has been improved with a more accurate timer, milestone death counters, and milestone callouts.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Visual and UI Updates[/b] – The title screen has been completely redone with new visuals and animations, while in-game presentation has been polished with refined effects, cleaner UI, and stronger atmosphere.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Movement & Death Effects[/b] – Added new motion and impact visuals to give the player’s actions and failures more weight.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bug Fixes & Polish[/b] – Countless fixes, optimizations, and small touches across every system.[/p][/*][/list][p]This re-haul is designed to elevate [b]Vertical Velocity[/b] into its best form yet: more content, more style, and a smoother, more cohesive experience from start to finish.[/p][p]Late October is right around the corner—I can’t wait for you to play this version.[/p]
